about: The third account's Mega Catch Cup party from 2026-11-27 (the owner: 'let's do this team now'): Araquanid in place of Thievul, measured +4.9 ± 0.8 against the cup's real teams (docs/status.md). In party order (Clodsire, Araquanid, Snorlax: Araquanid swapped into Thievul's place on the cup's party screen). Clodsire and Snorlax as in data/team_third.json; Araquanid rank 1 for Great League (level 35, 0/10/15: CP 1500 and HP 140 on its page), its moves read off its page. Charged moves as the page lists them; the live player checks the button order against the labels when each first comes out.
